title: Candle (OHLCV bar)
description: One OHLCV bar. NO STORE EXISTS: there is no candle table in db/schema/ (grep `candle` over db/schema/ returns none), so bars are read live per request and never persisted. The bar series identity is (instrument, interval, open_time). An unreported volume is null, never 0.

interval.description: Venue bar size; the TS allowlist is TICKER_TIMEFRAMES = ['1m','5m','15m','1h','4h','1d','1w'] (apps/web/src/features/market/ticker/client.ts), max 500 bars per request.

volume.description: Null when unreported - never 0 ('unreported volume is empty, not zero').
